note: Recorded by MaskTests on the synthetic 96×65 ramp image; masks m-br (brush: 3-point paint stroke + erase stroke, +0.5 EV) and m-cr (colour range over the two ramp ends, tolerance 0.15 / smoothness 0.6, amount 60, −0.8 EV, +20 sat). 8-bit quantised digests so a GPU family change does not invalidate the frame; re-record only when a kernel change is intended.
